criteria.ac: PT-01: Literal nonsecret YAML replaces properties and placeholders while preserving security, namespace, profile and fail-closed defaults.
criteria.reason: Host Copilot ignore policy refused the intended application.yml write; properties remain. No bypass or waiver.

criteria.ac: PT-02: Persistent annual membership CRUD, renewal history, amounts, destinations and expiry filtering.
criteria.reason: Create/reload/renewal/history/archive were exercised; full edit, destination and filter edge acceptance is not independently complete.

criteria.ac: PT-03: Calendar-month-before reminders with clamping and deduplication; real email remains required and unverified without a provider, WeChat optional.
criteria.reason: Date rules pass, but required real SMTP delivery and persistent scheduling are not implemented/configured; WeChat also remains unconfigured.

criteria.ac: PT-04: Proven-library encrypted personal vault with unlock/lock, safe reveal/copy, encrypted persistence/backup and failure-safe restore.
criteria.reason: Vault entry is disabled, not a functional encrypted vault. Dependency safety and interoperability enablement gates have not passed.

criteria.ac: PT-05: Persistent independent rich-text/Markdown notes with tags/search/archive, safe images/attachments and import/export.
criteria.reason: Source/tag/image persistence and archive/search pass in the browser; rendered Markdown preview and comprehensive rich-text/import/export/security-negative evidence are still missing.

criteria.ac: PT-06: Three native Art Design Pro menu/routes and usable desktop/mobile flows without resetting existing data or changing the backend-preview boundary.
criteria.reason: Route tests/build and three note viewports pass; disabled vault and incomplete comprehensive browser workflows preclude full three-module acceptance.

criteria.ac: PT-07: Real focused/full tests and independent/browser evidence; missing live notifications stay honestly degraded.
criteria.reason: Independent automatic gates pass and bounded parent browser checks pass; all acceptance edges and live integrations remain incomplete, without a waiver or delivery claim.

criteria.ac: PT-08: User addendum requires com.deeplazy.bingo root and controller/service/entity/mapper layers, matching current source/test directories, preserved framework scanning and no fake business classes.
